description: This file defines Flutter UI components for displaying a list of categories, including category data models, a categories list widget, and individual category buttons with interactive behavior.

classes.name: CategoryModel
classes.description: Data model representing a category with a name, optional SVG icon source, and optional route.

classes.name: Categories
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a horizontally scrollable list of categories.

classes.name: CategoryBtn
classes.description: A stateless widget representing an individual clickable category button with visual active/inactive states.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for each widget: 'Categories' builds a scrollable row of 'CategoryBtn's, 'CategoryBtn' builds an individual button widget.
